🛥️ Ready to build a real-time shipping platform that connects inland transport signals to the maritime world?
At Thales Romania, you’ll work on a modern Fullstack solution (Portal + APIs) used by internal and external customers where your Java, Spring Boot, and front-end skills directly improve how containers are tracked, monitored, enriched, and delivered.
 Senior Fullstack Developer (Java/Spring Boot/React) – Build Real Time Inland & Maritime Tracking Systems
 🎯 Mission:
 Join a passionate global team driving front-line innovation across industries.
For a top shipping company, we’re enhancing container maritime tracking with real-time land transport monitoring (inland tracking) within a carrier haulage context.
 You will contribute to a platform that:
collects data from multiple providers,
processes and enriches it,
and distributes it via a Portal (Cockpit + web modules) and API services for both internal and external users.
 ✅ What you’ll do:
Design and develop Portal/Cockpit modules using Java / Spring Boot
Build and maintain front-end features with Angular/ReactJS and TypeScript
Integrate with back-end services and data sources via REST APIs and WebSockets
Collaborate daily with functional experts in a governance-oriented way
Support CI/CD deployment workflows (XLR / XLD or equivalent)
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute actively to continuous improvement
 👉 Technical Skills:
Strong expertise in Java (8 to 25) — minimum 11 required
Spring Boot (significant knowledge)
Front-end: JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and/or ReactJS
Web design: HTML, CSS
Web-oriented architecture: RESTful web services, Swagger/OpenAPI
SQL: PostgreSQL (Oracle is a plus)
Hibernate / JPA / Flyway
JUnit (strong knowledge)
Git
Proven experience in portal / web application development

Willing to take responsibility and act independently

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.
